version.approval_notes:
The extension code is minified by Bun's bundler. The attached source archive is the tagged commit of https://github.com/ovidijusr/browsteer-ext.

To reproduce the build (Bun 1.3.9, any OS):
  bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
  bun run scripts/build.ts firefox
The output in dist/firefox is what was submitted. BUILD.md maps each source file to its output.

The extension talks only to a local bridge program at ws://127.0.0.1:8787 that the user runs themselves (bridge/ in the source). It collects no data. The access rules are in extension/src/policy.ts and SECURITY.md. To try it: run the bridge as described in README.md, click the toolbar button, choose "Allow Claude for 1 hour", allow a site, and pair Claude Code with the key shown.
